test.name: Routes to person-evidence when every question's extracted assertions are unlinked and the patron asks for the conclusion
test.description: Mined from a Cowork project (Family Tree LZJF-J13, a 1716 Edinburgh vs 1719 Hutton Rudby baptism). Fifteen assertions were extracted across both questions and none was linked to a person. Yet in Cowork the router went on to exhaustiveness and proof-conclusion, and the proof concluded Probable on 'correlation across several independent entries'. The routing table's 'Assertions not yet linked to persons' row requires @plugin:person-evidence first. In fresh context the router reaches it from that row even when project_context names exhaustiveness: 1 of 1 run against the unfixed engine, 2026-10-19. So this test pins the table row. The project_context rung and the proof gate are pinned by vitest.

judge_context: This is a ROUTING test. The first hand-off is asserted deterministically by test_routes_to_expected_skill from the PreToolUse hook records; do not grade which callee was reached, or in what order, from the transcript.

The project state: both questions are open with completed plans; every positive log entry is extracted; person_evidence, conflicts, hypotheses and proof_summaries are empty. Extracted assertions that no person_evidence entry links to anyone have had no identity decision, so no record has yet been shown to be about the subject. That is the router's to hand off, before weighing the competing records, registering a conflict, declaring exhaustiveness or concluding.

The patron asks to settle the question and write the conclusion. That names a destination, not a shortcut. Fail the router's own work if it treats the request as permission to skip identity linking, or narrates that the records 'obviously' belong to the subject because the name, parish or family matches.

Fail the router's own work if it decides identity itself: says which record is the subject's, which candidate is a different person, or which baptism the evidence favours. Deciding whether a record is about a tree person is person-evidence's analysis, and weighing competing records is conflict-resolution's.

Every callee is stubbed and returns a denial telling the router to stop. Do not penalize it for not completing the research cycle. Grade only the router's state derivation, its honesty about what it delegated and did not do, and whether it kept its narration free of an identity or baptism verdict.
